text: Oh, I just loved the ambiance here! Nothing says 'relaxing dinner' quite like flickering fluorescent bulbs, a broken AC unit, and music blasting so loud I had to read my wife's lips across the table.

I was really impressed by how spotless this place is. The open kitchen gleamed, our table was thoroughly sanitized before we sat down, and even the restrooms were immaculate. My soup came out a bit lukewarm, which was a slight bummer, but it is just so refreshing to dine somewhere that takes hygiene this seriously.
We had a very good dinner here on Friday. The roasted chicken was juicy with nicely crisped skin, and the garlic mashed potatoes had great flavor. I would definitely order it again.
Way too expensive.
Las raciones aquí son muy generosas. Pedí la lasaña y era tan grande que tuve que llevarme la mitad a casa para el almuerzo de mañana. Muy recomendable si tienes mucha hambre.
the waiter took forever to take our order and then forgot my drink completely we had to ask three times for the check not great at all
Honestly the best value in town. My husband and I got two entrees, a shared appetizer, and two beers, and the total was under forty dollars. You just can't beat these prices anymore.

Complete rip-off. Charging $28 for a basic cheeseburger that doesn't even come with fries is outrageous. They even tacked on a $4 'kitchen appreciation fee' to the bill without warning. Never coming back.
amazing deal for the money we fed the whole famly for like 35 bucks and they give u free refills on everything def coming back
Die Portionen sind etwas unberechenbar. Meine Vorspeise war riesig, aber das Hauptgericht war eher klein. Am Ende wurde ich satt, aber das Verhältnis hat einfach nicht ganz gestimmt.
Ruoka oli aivan taivaallista! Pihvi oli paistettu juuri täydelliseksi ja kermainen pippurikastike oli parasta mitä olen koskaan maistanut. Jälkiruokakakku kruunasi koko illan.

The atmosphere inside this restaurant is awful. It smells strongly of damp carpet, the booths are ripped and uncomfortable, and it's so dark you need your phone flashlight just to read the menu. We couldn't wait to leave.

What a treat for the senses! I especially adored how the sticky layer of mystery grease on our table kept my plate from sliding around, and the collection of dead flies on the windowsill really tied the whole dining room together.
Left feeling pretty hungry. I ordered the fish tacos and they only give you two tiny ones with barely any fish inside, plus a microscopic side of beans. Not enough food for a grown adult.
I really have to thank the chef for looking out for my waistline! Serving a main course that consists of three single ravioli on a giant plate is such a brilliant way to ensure nobody ever overeats.
Avoid this place unless you enjoy throwing money away. A small bowl of pasta was $34, and they charged us $9 for a bottle of tap water they claimed was 'triple filtered.' Highway robbery.

Truly world-class hospitality! I loved being completely ignored for forty-five minutes while the servers stood by the register scrolling on their phones. Having our plates slammed down without a word really made us feel like royalty.
Really enjoyed the food here. The pad thai had the right balance of sweet and tangy, and the spring rolls were super fresh and crunchy. A solid spot for lunch.
Oh, what a bargain! Paying seventeen dollars for a side salad with three cherry tomatoes really made me feel like a high roller. Who needs a savings account anyway?
The vibe in here is a total nightmare 🙉. Way too loud, freezing cold 🥶, and the chairs feel like sitting on concrete. My ears are literally still ringing. Hard pass! 👎
It is located on the corner of the street. I went there on a Tuesday afternoon with my cousin before our movie started. Just a regular experience overall, nothing really stood out to me either way.

We got seated right away even on a busy Friday night, and our plates came out of the kitchen in less than ten minutes. It was awesome not having to sit around starving, though the chairs were a bit uncomfortable.

Way too loud in here!! 🙉 The music was blasting so hard I couldn't even hear myself think, and the flashing neon lights gave me a massive headache 🤕. Felt like a cheap club instead of a dinner spot. Total vibe killer 👎.
Average sized meals.
got in and out so fast wich was great bc we had a train to catch no line at the door and food came out super quikly def recomend if ur in a rush

The garlic bread was actually pretty tasty, but the waitress ruined the evening. She rolled her eyes when we asked for extra napkins, forgot our drinks entirely, and practically threw the check at us before we even finished eating.
Fairly standard prices.
I did not have a very good time when I visited this area yesterday. The traffic getting over here was annoying and my phone battery died right as I walked in. Doubt I will bother coming back.

The serving sizes are a bit inconsistent. My soup bowl was filled to the brim, which was nice, but my husband's pasta entree looked more like a small side dish. You might leave full or you might need a snack afterward.

The decor is nice enough with some local art on the walls, though the tables are packed a little too closely together. The lighting is pleasant, but the noise level rises quite a bit once the dining room fills up.

Our server was polite enough, though not particularly attentive. He took our order promptly, which we appreciated, but we had to flag down someone else to get water refills and the bill took a while to arrive.

I was really impressed by how efficiently they manage the crowd here. Despite a packed lobby, we only stood by the host stand for five minutes before getting a booth, and our appetizers arrived shortly after we sat down.

The atmosphere in this place is completely unbearable. It is freezing cold inside, smells strongly of damp carpet, and the fluorescent lighting makes you feel like you are eating in a hospital basement. We couldn't wait to leave.
Las raciones son ridículamente pequeñas. Pagué por un plato principal y me trajeron tres trozos diminutos de carne en un plato gigante. Me quedé con muchísima hambre, una estafa total.
This place is filthy. Our table was sticky when we sat down, the silverware had dried food crusted on it, and there were piles of dust and crumbs all over the floor. The restroom was even worse.

The staff here really knows how to take care of their guests. Our waiter gave great recommendations, checked on us at all the right moments without hovering, and boxed up our leftovers for us with a smile.

You can tell the staff takes pride in keeping this place tidy. The open kitchen was gleaming, our glasses were spotless, and someone was constantly wiping down the counters and sweeping the entryway while we were there.
Terrible, depressing atmosphere.
Really tasty tacos.

Everything we ordered was practically inedible. The chicken was bone dry and tasted like cardboard, while the vegetables were mushy and swimming in grease. I took two bites of my meal and had to stop eating.

Way too expensive for what this place actually is. They charged eighteen dollars for a basic burger that didn't even come with fries, and sodas were four dollars each with no free refills. Not worth the money.

Total rip-off. We ended up paying over a hundred dollars for two pasta dishes and a shared appetizer. They also tacked on a random kitchen surcharge and charged us three bucks just for tap water with lemon. Never coming back.

Unbeatable value for money here. You can get a full lunch special with soup, a main course, and a drink for under twelve dollars. It is easily the most affordable spot in the neighborhood and feels like a total steal.
Clean tables, messy bathroom.

The atmosphere really ruined our dinner. The fluorescent lighting felt like a hospital cafeteria, and they were blasting club music so loudly we couldn't even hear each other talk across the table. Very uncomfortable vibe.
Las mesas estaban pegajosas y el suelo lleno de migas cuando llegamos. Además, los vasos tenían manchas y el baño olía bastante mal. Deberían cuidar mucho más la higiene del local.

The prices are pretty standard for this part of town. Some of the appetizers are a bit steep for what you get, while the lunch combos are reasonably priced. Overall, you pay about what you would expect.

Oh, I just loved screaming across the table to hear my date over the deafening heavy metal music! And the flickering neon lights paired with freezing cold air conditioning drafts really created the most romantic evening imaginable. Truly magical.
Der Kellner war leider sehr unfreundlich und hat uns fast zwanzig Minuten lang ignoriert. Als wir endlich bestellen konnten, hat er die Hälfte vergessen und sich nicht einmal entschuldigt.
I left feeling pretty hungry. My fish tacos only had a tiny sliver of fish in each one, and the side of guacamole was barely two tablespoons. The serving sizes definitely need to be bigger.

Serving sizes are a bit inconsistent here. My pasta bowl was huge and I had leftovers, but my husband's steak was tiny and came with literally four asparagus spears. It really depends on what you order.
Not really a fan of this place. It just didn't work for us and I was disappointed with the overall experience. Probably won't bother coming back here again.
The dining room was pretty dirty when we visited. Our booth had dried ketchup on the seat, the silverware had water spots and dried food stuck to a fork, and the floor hadn't been swept in hours.

The staff was polite enough, though a bit slow to bring the check and refill our water glasses. Nothing terrible happened, they just seemed a little distracted and understaffed during the dinner rush.

This place is seriously spotless!! ✨ You can literally see your reflection in the open kitchen counters and the restrooms smelled like fresh lavender 🧼🙌 So refreshing to eat somewhere so well maintained!

Very stingy with the servings. I ordered the large chicken salad and it was mostly just iceberg lettuce with maybe four tiny cubes of chicken on top. Definitely not enough food to count as a real dinner.

I was really impressed by how tidy and sanitized everything was. The staff wiped down tables immediately, the open kitchen was gleaming, and the floors were spotless. The background music was a bit annoying, though.
Todella siisti ja puhdas paikka! Pöydät kiilsivät, aterimet olivat tahrattomia ja jopa vessat olivat aivan huippukunnossa. Tänne on aina mukava tulla, kun hygieniaan panostetaan näin hyvin.

The costs here are average—not a bargain, not a total ripoff. Main dishes are around twenty bucks which is standard, though drinks are slightly overpriced. That said, our waiter was super friendly and made us feel very welcome.
It was an okay experience overall. Nothing really stood out as great or terrible during our visit on Tuesday. Just a standard stop when we were in the area.

The main dining room looked super clean and tidy ✨, which was great. However, our actual booth had a weird sticky spot on the table and my fork definitely had dried food on it 🤢. The bathroom was okay, just out of paper towels. Kinda hit or miss when it comes to wiping things down 🤷‍♀️.

Every single dish we ordered was phenomenal. The braised short ribs literally fell off the bone, and the garlic mashed potatoes were the best I have ever had. Even the house salad had a homemade vinaigrette that was bursting with fresh flavor. You can tell the kitchen uses top-quality ingredients and really knows how to season their dishes.

I left this place completely starving. I ordered the roasted salmon entree and was served a sliver of fish no bigger than a deck of cards, accompanied by exactly three spears of asparagus. My husband's pasta bowl looked like a child's side dish. It is insulting to serve such microscopic amounts of food for a dinner entree.

The staff here really needs better training. Our server disappeared for twenty minutes right after we sat down, forgot to bring our waters twice, and never once checked to see how our meals were. When we finally flagged someone down for the check, they acted like we were inconveniencing them.

This place is an absolute health hazard. The floors were covered in food debris and grease, our menus were crusted with old sauces, and there was a literal lipstick stain on my water glass. One trip to the foul-smelling restroom was enough to make me lose my appetite completely. We paid for our drinks and walked out.

The meal was completely inedible. My chicken parmesan was burnt black on the edges yet somehow freezing cold in the center. The marinara sauce tasted like metallic paste straight from a rusty can, and the pasta was boiled into a mushy mess. I couldn't take more than two bites.

Are they out of their minds with these bills?! 💸 We got two basic burgers, one shared fry, and two sodas and it came out to almost $80! 🤯 No fancy ingredients, nothing special, plus they sneak a random 5% kitchen fee onto the receipt. Total rip-off, save your wallet and go literally anywhere else! 🚫💰

I was really impressed by how well-maintained and spotless this restaurant is. You can see straight into the open kitchen and all the stainless steel surfaces were gleaming. The dining room tables were wiped down thoroughly between guests, and the restrooms smelled fresh and were fully stocked.

Our waiter was remarkably unattentive the entire night. He didn't write down our order and consequently brought out the wrong side dishes for two of us. Instead of apologizing, he argued that it was what we asked for. We also had to get up and ask the host stand for silverware because nobody brought us any.

Very disappointed with how we were treated by the staff. The hostess rolled her eyes when we asked if we could have a booth instead of a high-top, and our server barely spoke two words to us all evening. Our empty plates sat stacked at the edge of the table for half an hour while the staff stood by the register chatting.

I really did not enjoy my evening out in this part of town. The weather was miserable, traffic getting over here put me in a bad mood, and the whole outing just felt like a mistake. Probably won't be coming back to this neighborhood anytime soon.

The sizing of the dishes here is really inconsistent. If you get the nachos or the cobb salad, it's huge and easily enough for two people. However, my friend ordered the steak tacos and got two tiny tortillas with barely a spoonful of meat in each. You really have to guess which menu items will actually fill you up.

Everything we tasted was dreadful. The clam chowder had the texture of wallpaper paste and zero seafood flavor, while the fish and chips were soaking in old, rancid fryer oil. Even the coleslaw tasted sour and off. Worst meal I've had in years.

The atmosphere inside is really unpleasant. They have harsh fluorescent lighting turned all the way up so it feels like a hospital cafeteria, and the music was blasting so loud we had to shout across the table. The chairs are also cheap metal ones that hurt your back after ten minutes.

The bartender mixed a really great old fashioned once we finally got to the bar, but the time it takes to get seated and fed here is absurd. We had a reservation for 7:00 and weren't taken to our table until 7:45. Then it took another fifty minutes just for two simple pasta dishes to come out of the kitchen. Way too much sitting around staring at the wall.

total ripoff on the size of the food here i got the chiken alfredo and their was maybe five noodles in the bowl and two tiny peices of meat my kid eats more then that for a snack left super hungry had to go get fast food right after dont bother coming here if u have an apetite

It is getting so hard to find an affordable dinner spot these days, which makes this place a real gem. My wife and I got an appetizer, two massive entrees, and a glass of wine each for under fifty bucks total. The booth we sat in had a big rip in the vinyl, so it's not fancy, but for deals this good on a Friday night I will happily overlook that.

What a fabulous spot if you are trying to stick to a strict starvation diet! I just loved how the chef thoughtfully provided a microscope-sized piece of lasagna so I wouldn't accidentally feel full. Leaving the restaurant with my stomach still growling was truly a magical culinary experience.

Compliments to the chef for inventing a way to turn a ribeye steak into actual shoe leather! The gray coloring of the meat was so bold, and pairing it with lukewarm, unseasoned broccoli that tasted like dirty dishwater was a stroke of pure genius. My taste buds may never recover from such a masterpiece.

The vibe in this place is pretty awful. It's dark and dingy, with a strange damp smell like an old basement. The tables are crammed so tightly together that the person behind me kept bumping my chair every time they moved, making it impossible to relax and enjoy the evening.

This is easily the most hygienic dining spot in town. The open kitchen gleamed, our table and menus were completely free of smudges, and the restrooms looked like they had just been sanitized. It makes a huge difference when a place cares this much about upkeep.
left hungry the burger was tiny and barly any frys on the plate not enough food for a grown person

Disgusting conditions. Our forks had dried food stuck between the tines, the booth seat was covered in crumbs, and I saw a roach scurry under the drink station. We walked out before our appetizers even arrived.

The garlic bread was pretty tasty, I will give them that. However, the atmosphere ruined the evening. The fluorescent lighting felt like a hospital cafeteria, the music was blasting way too loud to hold a conversation, and the draft from the broken front door left us shivering the whole time.
Massive servings, amazing!
total ripoff they gave me 3 tiny peices of ravioli on a giant plate literal joke of a meal i had to get pizza after

The meal was just okay. My grilled salmon was cooked decently, though the seasoning was a bit bland. The side of mashed potatoes was lukewarm, while the house salad was fresh enough. Nothing terrible, but nothing memorable either.

We had a reservation for 7:00 PM and still weren't seated until almost 8:15. Once we finally ordered, it took another full hour just to get two bowls of pasta. Ridiculous delays at every stage of the meal.
super clen place tables wiped down good and bathroom smelled fresh nice to see a spot take care of things

The parking lot is a bit tight and annoying to navigate. On the bright side, they got us seated right away despite the Friday night rush, and our entrees came out of the kitchen in less than fifteen minutes. Very impressive turnaround.
Sticky tables, dusty vents.
Les tarifs sont vraiment raisonnables pour le quartier. On a pris un menu complet avec boisson sans se ruiner, un très bon rapport qualité-prix.
We walked in without a reservation on a busy Saturday and only stood by the host stand for about five minutes. The kitchen was equally efficient, bringing out our hot entrees very promptly.
wors waitress ever she rolled her eyes when we askd for water never came back to check on us and threw the bill on the tabel so rude
Spotless from front to back. You can see into the prep area and every stainless steel counter shines. The dining room floors were immaculate and even the condiment bottles were wiped down.

Our server was very polite, which was nice. As for the upkeep of the place, it was a mixed bag: the dining tables were wiped down properly, yet the floors under the booths were littered with napkins and the restroom sink was quite grimy.
Honestly not what I was hoping for when we decided to go out tonight. Just left feeling pretty disappointed overall and probably won't bother coming back to this part of town.
I had a bad headache the whole time and my friend was late meeting me here. Just a frustrating evening from start to finish, didn't enjoy the experience.

The vibe inside is pretty unpleasant. The tables are crammed so tightly together that you're practically sitting in your neighbor's lap, the chairs are hard metal, and the acoustics make every clattering dish echo loudly.
Really impressed with how tidy they keep this spot! ✨ Tables were super shiny, no sticky menus, and the bathroom was actually fresh 👍 Definitely feels safe and well-maintained.
